data.name: BillingFaqLede
data.value: Anything else, ask the chat or write to sales.

data.name: BillingFaq1Answer
data.value: Anyone who signs in to edit: sellers, managers and admins. Read-only viewers are free, up to twice your number of seats.

data.name: BillingFaq2Question
data.value: Can we add or remove seats later?

data.name: BillingFaq2Answer
data.value: Add seats any time and pay only for the rest of the current month or year. Remove seats at your next renewal.

data.name: BillingFaq3Answer
data.value: By card on every plan, and by SEPA direct debit in the euro area. Yearly plans of 20 seats or more can pay by bank transfer against an invoice.

data.name: BillingFaq4Answer
data.value: No. VAT or sales tax is added at checkout where it applies. EU businesses that give us a valid VAT number are billed without VAT under the reverse charge.

data.name: BillingFaq5Answer
data.value: Monthly plans stop at the end of the month you cancel in. Yearly plans run to the end of the year you paid for. You can export everything at any time, before and after.

data.name: BillingFaq6Question

data.name: SheetsDescription
data.value: Where a spreadsheet is still the better tool for your pipeline, where it starts to cost you deals, and four signs your team has reached the tipping point.

data.name: SheetsTitle
data.value: Brightlane or a spreadsheet? An honest comparison.

data.name: SheetsLede
data.value: Most teams start their pipeline in a spreadsheet, and for a while it's the right tool. Here is where it stays the better choice, where it starts to cost you deals, and how to tell which side of that line your team is on.

data.name: SheetsArtNote
data.value: Two people edited row 3 at the same time. One of them won.

data.name: Win1Body
data.value: It comes with your office software, and nobody needs a new login.

data.name: Win2Body
data.value: A new column takes five seconds. In Brightlane a custom field takes a minute, and an admin.

data.name: Win3Body
data.value: No training at all. Most sellers need about an hour to find their way around Brightlane.

data.name: Win4Body
data.value: If your commission plan is a formula, a spreadsheet will run it. Brightlane's reports don't do arbitrary maths.

data.name: SheetsCostsTitle
data.value: Where it starts to cost you

data.name: Cost1Body
data.value: When two sellers edit the same deal, the last one to save wins. Brightlane keeps every change, with a name and a time.

data.name: Cost2Body
data.value: A spreadsheet reminds nobody. Brightlane gives every deal a next step, and lists the deals that don't have one.

data.name: Cost3Body
data.value: It works until someone sorts one column and not the others, and nobody notices until the quarter ends.

data.name: Cost4Body
data.value: The history of a deal sits in one seller's mailbox. When they leave, it leaves with them.

data.name: Cost5Title
data.value: On a phone, it's a struggle

data.name: Cost5Body
data.value: Updating a sheet with 30 columns on a phone after a meeting is the update that rarely happens.

data.name: AboutDescription
data.value: Brightlane makes a CRM for sales teams that are too big for a spreadsheet and too small for a CRM project. 46 people in Dublin and Lisbon.

data.name: AboutLede
data.value: We make a CRM for sales teams that are too big for a spreadsheet and too small for a CRM project. 46 of us, in Dublin and Lisbon, work for 1,400 of those teams.

data.name: StoryBody1
data.value: Aoife Brennan ran sales for a logistics software company with 11 sellers. Their CRM had been bought for a 400-person sales floor. It took a full-time admin to keep it running, and the team kept its real pipeline in a spreadsheet anyway.

data.name: StoryBody2
data.value: In 2019 she and Tomás Ferreira, an engineer from the same company, built the tool they had wanted: one board, a forecast that does its own arithmetic, and nothing that needs an admin. Six teams from Aoife's old customers tried it first.

data.name: StoryBody3
data.value: We still ask every new team the question we asked those six: what did your spreadsheet do that we don't? The answers are on our roadmap, and on our comparison page.

data.name: TeamTitle
data.value: Some of the people behind it

data.name: ContactBody

data.name: NotFoundBody
